## 5. Acquiring equilibrium samples and a computable information floor

The model used for the complete construction has weights

\[
w(s)
=
\prod_{\{i,j\}}r_{ij}^{[s_i=s_j]}
\prod_i h_i^{[s_i=+1]},
\qquad
r_{ij}\ge1,\quad h_i>0,
\]

with all parameters rational. Its Hamiltonian is
\(H(s)=-\beta^{-1}\log w(s)\).

The single-site conditional probability is

\[
\Pr(s_i=+1\mid s_{-i})
=
\frac{h_i\prod_{j\sim i}r_{ij}^{s_j}}
     {1+h_i\prod_{j\sim i}r_{ij}^{s_j}}.
\]

It is rational and requires no partition function.

### Exact starts, with replay and randomness counted

The sampler uses monotone coupling from the past. It runs the same stored random maps on the all-minus and all-plus configurations. If they have not coalesced, it extends the past window while preserving every old map and its exposed random bits. Coalescence certifies the equilibrium draw. This mechanism and its Ising application originate with Propp and Wilson. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="3"}

For

\[
\zeta=\max_i\sum_{j\sim i}\frac{r_{ij}-1}{r_{ij}+1}<1,
\]

the proved bound for the implemented two-chain doubling scheme is

\[
\boxed{
\mathbb E K_{\mathrm{reset}}
\le
8\left[
1+\frac{N(\log N+1)}{1-\zeta}
\right],
}
\]

where \(K_{\mathrm{reset}}\) counts actual conditional-probability evaluations.

The proof separately bounds random-bit consumption, map storage, and rational arithmetic. Replayed uniform comparisons cannot simply be charged as fresh independent comparisons; the report supplies the finite-threshold-set argument needed for their bit cost.

Every finite positive model also has an explicit coalescing-word bound. With

\[
p_{i,\min}=\frac{h_i}{h_i+\prod_j r_{ij}},
\qquad
\eta=N^{-N}\prod_i p_{i,\min}>0,
\]

one obtains

\[
\mathbb E K_{\mathrm{reset}}\le \frac{8N}{\eta}.
\]

That bound can be exponentially poor. Eventual exact sampling has not been confused with rapid mixing.

### The actual reverse protocol

A forward stage changes the Hamiltonian and then relaxes. Its reverse must **relax first and then reverse the Hamiltonian change**.

The implemented path probabilities satisfy, exactly,

\[
\frac{P_F(\text{path})}
     {P_R(\text{reversed path})}
=
\frac{a}{z},
\qquad
a=e^{\beta W_F},
\qquad
z=\frac{Z_A}{Z_B}.
\]

Exact enumeration through the execution code verifies this identity. Deliberately reversing the operations in the wrong order fails it.

## 7. From pair measurements to a certified landscape

For an edge \(u\to v\), let the rational certificate be

\[
\ell_{uv}
\le
e^{f_v-f_u}
\le
u_{uv}.
\]

Allocate edge error budgets whose sum is at most \(\alpha\). Taking minimum products along directed paths gives tight bounds implied by all edge intervals. Rational Floyd–Warshall closure computes all pairs in \(O(|V|^3)\) arithmetic operations.

A directed cycle with upper-bound product below one makes the constraints inconsistent. It therefore gives a level-\(\alpha\) rejection of the joint hypothesis that one free-energy potential and all declared work relations explain the observations.

That rejection does not identify which premise failed. Conversely, finite non-rejection does not establish exact physical consistency.

The closure is tight for the supplied intervals. MBAR already provides efficient joint estimation from multiple equilibrium states; I do not claim that graph closure supersedes its statistical efficiency. :chatgpt-content-reference{index="5"}
